p01.text: Picking fruit on piece rates this summer?

p03.text: One. Under the Horticulture Award, pieceworkers get a daily minimum:

p04.text: at least the hourly rate for your level, times the hours you worked.

p05.text: For an adult level one casual, that's thirty-two dollars eighteen an hour.

p06.text: Two. Pick fast and your piece rate pays more?

p08.text: And a good day can't be used to cover a slow one.

p09.text: Three. Before you start, your employer must give you

p10.text: a written piecework record, with the task and the piece rate.

p11.text: These rules apply whatever your visa.

p12.text: Send this to the mate you're picking with.
